method: Bundle the unchanged source sampler with esbuild, invoke sample() directly on the WSL host, then invoke it inside a systemd --user transient service with CPUQuota=100% and MemoryMax=256M. Assert cgroup-v2, effectiveCpu <= 1, totalMemoryMb <= 256, and availableMemoryMb <= totalMemoryMb.
limitations: Component observation only; does not satisfy a complete publication gate.
Executes the source sampler, not a complete installed-plugin Objective.
Does not prove pressure admission, concurrency, restart recovery, other Linux hosts, or paid burst.
